summary.text: Germano Martins is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Merrimack 10, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Germano Martins was a Democratic candidate for Merrimack 10 in 2024 and was defeated in the November general election.
Ballotpedia lists endorsements for his 2026 candidacy from the National Education Association and Rights and Democracy (RAD-NH).
